name: Bashemath
overview: The name Bashemath appears in Scripture primarily as one of the wives of Esau, identified as the daughter of Elon the Hittite and also as Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth. She bore Esau a son named Reuel, who became the father of several leaders in the land of Edom. These passages highlight Bashemath's role in the genealogy and tribal leadership among Esau's descendants, emphasizing the fulfillment of God's providential plan through the lineage of Esau.
